summary: A couples photo scrapbook app where two users pair their accounts, upload photos to a shared scrapbook, and each photo gets an AI-generated caption. The UI presents photos in a scrapbook-style layout with authentication.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: Empty workspace — no existing project files detected.

questions.question: What type of application are you building?
questions.rationale: User wants a scrapbook UI for viewing photos plus a backend for uploads, auth, and AI captions — classic SPA + API.

options.label: Static site + API
options.description: Pre-built static frontend with serverless API

questions.question: Which runtime language?
questions.rationale: No runtime specified — TypeScript is the most common choice for SPA + API on Azure Functions.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: Photos map to Blob Storage; users, couples, photo metadata, and AI captions are relational data best modeled in PostgreSQL.

questions.question: Which frontend framework?
questions.rationale: No frontend framework specified — React is the most popular choice for SPA + API projects.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes your app needs.
questions.answer: Sign in/sign up, couple pairing via invite code, photo upload to shared scrapbook, photo gallery with scrapbook layout, AI-generated captions per photo, delete/manage photos, user profile
questions.rationale: Distilled from the user's prompt: auth, couple pairing, photo uploads, scrapbook UI, and AI captions.
questions.recommendedChoice: Sign in/sign up, couple pairing via invite code, photo upload to shared scrapbook, photo gallery with scrapbook layout, AI-generated captions per photo, delete/manage photos, user profile

questions.question: Does your app need authentication?
questions.rationale: User explicitly wants sign-in with authentication but didn't specify a provider. Mock auth middleware lets every protected route be fully testable without an external IdP — swap in a real provider (Entra ID, Auth0, Clerk, etc.) when ready.

options.label: Mock auth middleware
options.description: HMAC-signed test tokens — testable without an IdP

options.label: Microsoft Entra ID
options.description: Workforce identity — sign in with org or Microsoft accounts (formerly Azure AD)

options.label: Microsoft Entra External ID
options.description: Customer identity — sign-up plus social logins (formerly Azure AD B2C)

options.label: Auth0
options.description: Third-party IdP — social and enterprise connections

options.label: Clerk
options.description: Drop-in user management with prebuilt UI
